nodes.description: Owned.owner: privileged address set from msg.sender in constructor and reassigned through acceptOwnership; gates onlyOwner functions.
Owned.newOwner: pending owner set by transferOwnership and cleared to address(0) after acceptOwnership.
TokenERC20.symbol set once to 'OPRTNTY' in the TokenERC20 constructor.
TokenERC20.name set once to 'Oportunity Token' in the TokenERC20 constructor.
TokenERC20.decimals set once to 8 in the TokenERC20 constructor.
TokenERC20._totalSupply minted to owner in constructor and read by totalSupply().
TokenERC20.newun: guardian/restricted recipient address set by transfernewun and implicitly by the first transferFrom, blocking transfers to it.
TokenERC20.balances mapping of holder balances mutated by transfer and transferFrom.
TokenERC20.allowed nested mapping of allowances mutated by approve, transferFrom and approveAndCall.
Owned constructor: assigns owner = msg.sender at deployment.
transferOwnership(address): onlyOwner, stages a new owner in newOwner.
acceptOwnership(): requires msg.sender == newOwner then moves ownership and zeroes newOwner.
TokenERC20 constructor: sets metadata, mints _totalSupply to owner and emits Transfer.
transfernewun(address): onlyOwner, sets the restricted recipient newun used to block transfers.
totalSupply(): returns _totalSupply.sub(balances[address(0)]).
balanceOf(address): returns balances[tokenOwner].
transfer(address,uint): requires to != newun, debits msg.sender and credits to using SafeMath, emits Transfer.
approve(address,uint): writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens and emits Approval.
transferFrom(address,address,uint): initializes newun when unset, otherwise blocks transfers to newun, then moves balances and decrements allowance.
allowance(address,address): returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
approveAndCall(address,uint,bytes): sets allowance then calls receiveApproval on the spender contract (external callback before state is finalised).
OPORTUNITY.clearCNDAO(): onlyOwner, transfers the whole contract balance to msg.sender.
TokenERC20 fallback: external payable that always reverts, rejecting plain ether.
OPORTUNITY fallback: external payable that silently accepts ether into the contract.
msg.sender read in the Owned constructor and stored as owner.
msg.sender read in acceptOwnership and compared with newOwner to seize ownership.
msg.sender read in transfer, its balance is debited and it is emitted as the Transfer sender.
msg.sender read in transferFrom, used to decrement allowed[from][msg.sender].
msg.sender read in approveAndCall and forwarded to the untrusted spender contract.
msg.sender read in clearCNDAO as the owner check and the ETH transfer recipient.
msg.sender read in approve and used as the allowance owner key.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(...) to an attacker-controlled address inside approveAndCall.
Native ETH transfer of the entire contract balance to msg.sender inside clearCNDAO.
Implicit privileged state write newun = to inside transferFrom when newun is unset, letting the first caller pick the restricted address.
OPORTUNITY payable fallback accepts arbitrary ether, funding the owner-drainable balance.
Parameter _newOwner of transferOwnership(address).
Parameter to of transfer(address,uint).
Parameter tokens of transfer(address,uint).
Parameter spender of approve(address,uint).
Parameter tokens of approve(address,uint).
Parameter from of transferFrom(address,address,uint).
Parameter to of transferFrom(address,address,uint).
Parameter tokens of transferFrom(address,address,uint).
Parameter spender of approveAndCall(address,uint,bytes), also the external call target.
Parameter tokens of approveAndCall(address,uint,bytes).
Parameter data of approveAndCall(address,uint,bytes), forwarded to the callee.
Parameter tokenOwner of balanceOf(address).
Parameter _newun of transfernewun(address).
Local address payable _owner in clearCNDAO holding msg.sender before the balance transfer.

edges.reason: Owned constructor assigns owner = msg.sender.
Constructor reads msg.sender to initialise ownership.
Untrusted msg.sender is stored as owner, granting all onlyOwner privileges.
onlyOwner writes newOwner, staging a privileged ownership transfer.
acceptOwnership rewrites owner to newOwner.
msg.sender must equal newOwner for ownership to move.
newOwner is reset to address(0) after ownership acceptance.
Token constructor sets symbol.
Token constructor sets name.
Token constructor sets decimals.
Token constructor sets _totalSupply.
Token constructor mints the whole supply to owner in balances.
onlyOwner sets the restricted address newun that can block transfers.
totalSupply reads _totalSupply.
totalSupply subtracts balances[address(0)] from the stored supply.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
transfer debits msg.sender and credits the recipient in balances.
transfer is gated by require(to != newun), so newun can block recipient transfers.
msg.sender invokes transfer.
msg.sender balance is debited inside transfer.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
msg.sender invokes approve and owns the allowance entry.
msg.sender is the first key into the allowed mapping.
transferFrom moves balances[from] to balances[to].
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender].
transferFrom either sets newun or requires to != newun, controlling recipient eligibility.
msg.sender invokes transferFrom as the spender.
msg.sender is the spender key when allowance is decremented.
transferFrom triggers the implicit newun state write when it is unset.
The first caller of transferFrom permanently chooses the privileged newun address.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] before the external call.
approveAndCall reaches the external receiveApproval call on the spender contract.
msg.sender invokes approveAndCall.
msg.sender is forwarded into the untrusted callback as the original approver.
The data parameter is passed into the external receiveApproval callback.
The external contract called by approveAndCall can re-enter token functions (approve/transferFrom) before approveAndCall returns.
clearCNDAO performs the native ETH transfer of the contract balance.
msg.sender invokes clearCNDAO.
msg.sender is both the onlyOwner check and the ETH recipient, so the owner drains the balance.
clearCNDAO is guarded by onlyOwner comparing msg.sender to owner.
The payable fallback of OPORTUNITY accepts ether.
Ether accumulated by the OPORTUNITY fallback is the value drained by clearCNDAO.
_newOwner parameter is consumed by transferOwnership.
to parameter is consumed by transfer.
tokens parameter is consumed by transfer.
spender parameter is consumed by approve.
tokens parameter is consumed by approve.
from parameter is consumed by transferFrom.
to parameter is consumed by transferFrom.
tokens parameter is consumed by transferFrom.
spender parameter is consumed by approveAndCall and used as call target.
tokens parameter is consumed by approveAndCall.
data parameter is consumed by approveAndCall.
tokenOwner parameter is used to index balances in balanceOf.
_newun parameter is consumed by transfernewun.
Local _owner holds msg.sender before the balance transfer in clearCNDAO.

normalization_plan.reason: _newOwner only carries the pending-owner value written into newOwner by transferOwnership; merge into that function.
to is only used as the recipient index inside transfer; merge into the transfer function.
tokens only quantifies the transfer amount inside transfer; merge into the transfer function.
spender is only the allowance key in approve; merge into the approve function.
tokens is only the allowance value in approve; merge into the approve function.
from is only the debited balance key in transferFrom; merge into the transferFrom function.
to is only the credited balance key in transferFrom; merge into the transferFrom function.
tokens only quantifies the amount moved in transferFrom; merge into the transferFrom function.
spender is both the allowance key and the external call target of approveAndCall; merge into that function.
tokens only sets the allowance value in approveAndCall; merge into that function.
data is only forwarded to the external receiveApproval callback from approveAndCall; merge into that function.
tokenOwner is only a lookup key in balanceOf; merge into the balanceOf function.
_newun only supplies the restricted address stored by transfernewun; merge into that function.
_owner is a throwaway alias for msg.sender used solely as the recipient of the ETH transfer in clearCNDAO; merge it into the ETH transfer unsafe operation.
